name: FitBit
description: Lightweight, fast, and modern exercise finder built with React, Search exercises, view details, bookmark favorites, and watch related YouTube videos

paragraphs: A lightweight, fast, and simple web app to search for exercises, view details, and bookmark your favorites. Built for speed and usability, FitBit Exercise Finder helps you quickly discover new exercises and learn how to perform them.
features: Search Exercises: Find exercises by name with instant results.
Exercise Details: View equipment, difficulty, category, and a short description for each exercise.
YouTube Integration: Watch related exercise videos directly in the app.
Bookmarks: Save your favorite exercises for quick access.
Responsive Design: Works great on both desktop and mobile devices.
